[PROMO CODE FOR FREE SKIN @ 2500 LIKES!]

♿ Blocky Wheels: ragdoll physics racing with YOUR avatar!

🏁 RACE YOUR FRIENDS! Open a lobby, invite up to 3 other friends, pick a level and 3-2-1 GO! 

🛠️ BUILD YOUR OWN LEVELS! Drag in ground, ramps and every trap from the game, test-ride it, then publish it for everyone.

🌎 PLAY COMMUNITY LEVELS! Search and filter player levels, rate them 1-5 stars, ♥ your favorites and chase your best time.

🎮 PC, phone, tablet and controller. Suitable for all ages.

If you enjoyed, please leave a like, as this lets me know to pump more content out for you!
